subject: burrowback
disposition: Disabled asset-local review candidate; ordinary species selection remains unchanged

reference_prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Burrowback creature reference from the supplied established character image. ONE full-body three-quarter studio view of the same stout brown digging badger: distinctive broad cream central forehead stripe and cream muzzle/cheeks with charcoal eye masks, small rounded dark badger ears, warm golden-brown eyes, dark broad nose, thick brown fur, strong stocky limbs, large dark paws with three broad curved ivory digging claws, short thick tufted brown tail. Preserve the irregular grey stone slabs and small moss-green/ochre leaves across its back and shoulders, integrated into the heavy fur silhouette. Keep its friendly determined badger face and squat powerful proportions, not a puppy or boar. Neutral standing quadruped with four separated grounded paws, readable shoulders/elbows and hips/knees, belly visibly above the floor, head level with its spine and no exaggerated crouch. Tail separate and fully inside frame. Solid connected fur masses, broad integrated stone/leaf plates and solid short claws; no floating debris or thin hanging pieces. Replace any cheek whiskers with small flush painted marks: no projecting hair strands or wire/tube whiskers. Entire ears, body, claws and tail in frame with margin. Light-grey studio background, neutral soft lighting, clean detailed stylized game sculpt. No people, rulers, text, clothing, equipment, armor harness, particles, red accents, extra limbs or environment.

reference_inspection.riggability: Four separated grounded paws with broad solid digging claws; visible limb joints and separate tufted tail; no hanging hairs or floating fragments
reference_inspection.limits: Single view does not establish reverse anatomy, topology, rig or native approval
